exposure: delivery timing in academic year (early vs. late)
resident work hour limitation (before vs. after July 2003)
hospital type (teaching vs. non-teaching vs. teaching-intensive)
cohort: The study included 628,414 singleton births in Washington State from 1987 to 2012.
finding: Before resident work hour reform, women delivering early in the academic year at teaching hospitals had more complications, a difference that largely disappeared after the reform, with a decrease noted at teaching-intensive hospitals.
